answer: Chain bond: each identity locks 60 credits and joins a 3-link chain. A prism splits answers into bands; the next challenger checks one band, so a rented link fails the spectrum, burning both bonds. Links stack only on shale layers of prior work; a thousand fakes share none. Chains drift in a nebula pool, audited at random. Per fake: 45 plus a 60 lock; 1,000 fakes pay 105,000 for a 40,000 pool, losing 65,000. Honest agents run one chain, pay 45.
